column_description: A BIGSERIAL primary key for each fill/execution (e.g., 210345).
A DECIMAL(8,4) showing how many units were filled (e.g., '0.0500').
A NUMERIC(8,4) showing how many units remain unfilled (e.g., '0.0750').
A DECIMAL(12,3) capturing the fill price (e.g., '27699.150').
A DECIMAL(12,3) notional of the fill (e.g., '1384.958').
A TIMESTAMP if the partial fill or order slice expires (e.g., '2025-05-10 15:00:00').
An enum (CancelNote_enum) describing cancel reason (Expired, InsufficientFunds, UserRequested).
An enum (ExecTune_enum) indicating execution style (Maker, Taker).
A CHAR(36) referencing Orders(RecordVault) to link back to the original order.
